source_boundary: Official Eona, Organa, Waypoint and dungeon-system context plus independent secondary location guides. Coordinates are owned schematic placements, not copied game pins, not imported map coordinates and not first-hand verified routes.

EONAS_LEGACY.note: Meadow of Beginnings and Dragonrise Basin received a stop-loss source recheck; no VIDEO_VERIFIED or OFFICIAL_VERIFIED individual-location evidence was found.

ORGANA_STATUE.conflict_note: Four public guide-style sources and one trophy-style target source converge on 13 restoration entries; one public map guide reports 14 mapped Statue of Organa layer points without exposing a named 14th restoration entry. The production map publishes the 13 corroborated named entries and retains the 13 vs 14 conflict.

WARP_POINT.note: A public map-data-family source reports 20 mapped Warp Points. Sprint B1 publishes eight high-utility region anchors as SECONDARY_CORROBORATED, REGION_APPROXIMATE planning markers. Exact in-game pins, unlock conditions, costs and cooldowns are not verified.

DUNGEON.estimated_total: 26 mapped entrances / 30 activity records / 69 broad taxonomy records
DUNGEON.note: Sprint B2 publishes mapped entrances with independent activity/name corroboration. Story-only mapped entrances remain KNOWN_ACTIVITY_LOCATION_UNRESOLVED until independent corroboration is added.
